Ⅳ. LAWFUL AND PROPER USE OF THE SERVICES

 

4.1 Platform Rules

As a condition of using the Services, you agree to comply with all Platform Rules, Codes of Conduct, and Community Guidelines (collectively, “Regulations”).

  • If you disagree with any Platform Rules, your sole remedy is to stop using the relevant Service or feature.

 

4.2 Codes of Conduct

The Services provide tools to communicate and share content with other users, including chat, forums, live streaming, blogs, and user-generated content (“UGC”).

You acknowledge that:

  • UGC is controlled by users, not the Company.
  • The Company does not endorse or guarantee the accuracy, legality, or quality of any UGC.

You agree to always behave lawfully and properly, avoiding harm to the Company or other users. Specifically, you shall not:

  1. Post content that is obscene, pornographic, illegal, defamatory, harassing, threatening, or abusive.
  2. Infringe others’ contractual, personal, or intellectual property rights.
  3. Upload files containing viruses, malware, or harmful programs.
  4. Attempt to access other users’ accounts or private information.
  5. Develop, distribute, or use cheating, hacking, or automation tools that harm the Services or others.
  6. Exploit errors, bugs, or defects to gain unintended advantages.
  7. Violate applicable laws or promote illegal activities.
  8. Misuse customer service, technical support, or complaint channels, including making false reports or claims.
  9. Use the Services to infringe upon the Company’s commercial interests without authorization.

The above list is illustrative, not exhaustive. The Company may define additional improper conduct and take action under this Clause.

 

4.3 Community Guidelines

Users form the community; each is responsible for their own actions. While the Company does not actively monitor all content, users are expected to follow these guidelines:

Encouraged behaviors:

  • Engage positively with other users; invite friends to join.
  • Contribute high-quality content and constructive feedback.
  • Foster friendly, respectful interactions.

Prohibited behaviors:

  1. Conduct illegal activities (e.g., crimes, terrorism, hacking, piracy, drug use, illegal gambling).
  2. Share content negatively affecting minors, including sexual, violent, or abusive material.
  3. Violate others’ rights (privacy, IP, defamation, unauthorized use of likeness).
  4. Share content unsuitable for the community or with negative social impact (violence, extremism, self-harm, animal cruelty, discrimination).
  5. Threaten the physical or financial safety of others.
  6. Distribute malicious software or conduct phishing or hacking activities.
  7. Steal, manipulate, or alter others’ accounts or data.
  8. Organize harassment, raids, or mob behavior.
  9. Engage in spamming or deceptive contact.
  10. Share prohibited content, including deepfakes, without authorization.

The above list is illustrative, not exhaustive. The Company may update these guidelines at any time and take action under this Claus.

 

4.4 Consequences of Misuse

If you violate this Agreement, Regulations, or applicable laws, the Company may take, at its discretion, one or more of the following actions:

  1. Remove non-compliant content.
  2. Confiscate Virtual Items.
  3. Deduct your Account balance, revenue, or receivables.
  4. Restrict or terminate certain features or functions.
  5. Suspend or terminate your Account.
  6. Post public notices regarding your violation.

Repeated or severe violations may lead to more serious penalties.

You agree to indemnify and hold the Company harmless from any loss, liability, claim, or damage arising from:

  • Your use of the Services;
  • Violation of this Agreement;
  • Violation of third-party rights;

These remedies are cumulative and do not limit any legal rights or claims under law.
